engine_result.backlog_scope: Pending physics-step backlog is not exposed by the runtime API used; actual delta, tick wall gaps and render cadence are measured separately.

benchmark_performance.scope: Pre driver includes input and projection probe; post enrichment is read/copy only; existing trace cost separate. Per-row Performance.TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS is engine monitor of prior physics processing, not a stopwatch of this current solver tick.

instrumentation.cost_scope: post-probe snapshot, event derivation and JSON serialization only; excludes pre-probe, input emission, original observers and engine. External process timing needed for total overhead.
instrumentation.observer_off_scope: recorder OFF is not full gameplay-observer OFF

catch_native.scope: actual contacts and same runtime material anchor, B1 and ground contributions retained; original beyond-static .02m policy margin

trace.phase_scope: pre_control before application callbacks; post_control after existing application callbacks and before next integration; neither is falsely labelled post-solver
